description:
Does a traveller need a plug adapter or voltage converter? verdict {adapter: not_needed | needed | depends_on_plug, converter: not_needed | usually_not_needed | needed_for_single_voltage_devices | unknown, plug_fit[], frequency_note, guidance}, computed from cited plug, voltage and frequency facts (inputs[], with sources and confidence; top-level confidence is their lowest). Plug fit is conservative. For raw power facts use get_country_facts; for a whole trip get_trip_brief (includes this verdict per destination).
Parameters: home_country is where the devices were bought (their plugs and rating), not nationality; destination is where they will be plugged in. Example: {"home_country":"GB","destination":"US"}.
Read-only; keyless (free key or x402 lifts limits: https://citedtravel.com/pricing/); errors RFC 9457.

destination.description: Destination country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

home_country.description: Country where the traveller's devices come from as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

lang.description: Language for localized names (BCP 47). Supported: en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; aliases such as zh, zh-CN, zh-TW and zh-HK are mapped, and anything else falls back to English. Only names are localized; verbatim official quotes stay in their original language.

name: check_power_compatibility

attribution.description: Attribution strings to show to users when you display these facts.

confidence.description: Lowest confidence among the input facts.

reasons.description: Why the score is what it is.

dataset_version.description: Version of the dataset that answered.

from.description: Country (ISO codes and name, localized to lang).

inputs.description: The plug, voltage and frequency facts the verdict was computed from.

confidence.description: Deterministic confidence: score from 0 to 1, a level, and the reasons (source kind, cross-checks, staleness...).

reasons.description: Why the score is what it is.

last_verified.description: Date the value was last verified (YYYY-MM-DD).

license.description: License of the source, e.g. CC0-1.0, OGL-UK-3.0, MIT.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the source, when quoted.

source_value.description: The raw value as given by the source, when not quoted.

to.description: Country (ISO codes and name, localized to lang).

plug_fit.description: For each home plug type, the destination socket types it fits.

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): RFC 9457 problem, e.g. unknown country, no data, key required, rate limited, sanctions block.
anyOf.title: Error (problem details)

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): x402 v2 payment requirements. Pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"].
anyOf.title: Error (x402 payment request)

title: Power compatibility
